messages:
oncall-bot: 🚨 Pager: multiple alerts for model fetch failures from external artifact host (Hugging Face). Root cause unknown. Paging SRE oncall.

Asha M: seeing spike in 429/503 from HF when launching new containers. Cold starts failing to pull artifacts.

Asha M: symptomatic: new replica startup -> attempt to fetch model -> ~30s then 429 or socket timeout. backlog on model pull queue.

Priya S: confirmed. Grafana: surge in storage_fetch_errors and model_fetch_latency around 02:12 UTC. Link: https://grafana.redwood/app/d/abc123/model-fetch?from=now-1h

Tomas V: @Asha M can you paste a sample error from the runtime logs?

Asha M: here — snippet from worker logs:

```
2026-03-15T02:14:03Z ERROR model_fetcher.py: fetch_model(hf://redwood/gpt-xl) -> HTTP 429
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/runtime/model_fetcher.py", line 83, in fetch
    resp = requests.get(url, timeout=25)
requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 429 Client Error: Too Many Requests for url: https://huggingface.co/api/models/redwood/gpt-xl
```

Asha M: also seeing `502` and `504` intermittently.

Tomas V: probable third-party rate limiting on HF CDN. Are we using direct HF API or a mirror?

Asha M: direct HF model hosting + S3-backed mirrors for older models, but this particular model is only on HF. No mirror for this customer.

Priya S: Customer impact: onboarding flows and some inference cold starts failing for a subset of dedicated customers. Tickets from two SOC teams reporting elevated error rates.

customer-success-bot: Incoming customer report: "model download failed during initialization, fallback timed out" (cust-omega).

Tomas V: mitigation options (quick list):
- enable immediate fallback to smaller quantized variant already in cache
- serve from nearest mirror (if we can promote existing cached shard)
- warm a pool of pre-pulled containers with models pinned
- throttle rollout / switch traffic to hosted-compatible model variant

Asha M: experimenting with forcing cache fallback now by setting `MODEL_FETCH_STRATEGY=local_then_remote` on the infra config for the pool. Will report results.

infra-bot: Applying config change to pool `dedicated-eu-1` -> MODEL_FETCH_STRATEGY=local_then_remote (request id r-221).

Asha M: 02:21 UTC - after change, new instances now prefer cached quantized variants. Errors for cold starts dropped 70% for affected customers.

Tomas V: good. Create temporary circuit-breaker for HF fetches: small retry window + exponential backoff. Also add warning in routing so that if fetch rate > X we fallback to cached variant automatically.

Priya S: putting together customer impact note for post-incident: affected ~12 dedicated pods across 3 clusters, degraded cold-start success rate from 98% -> 64% for ~25 minutes. No data exfiltration.

Asha M: created internal mitigation runbook entry: `incidents/hf_artifact_rate_limit.md` with steps to flip cache-first behavior and how to promote cached artifacts.

Tomas V: reaching out to Hugging Face support (ticket created HF-4529) — included logs and request ids. Also asked for status update on repo throttling or ACL changes.

Asha M: HF responded: "We're investigating a surge and have applied a temporary stricter rate limit for unauthenticated artifact pulls. Recommend using authenticated CDN tokens or mirrors."

Priya S: immediate customer-facing mitigation: reach out to impacted customers telling them we're actively mitigating, recommending they pin to a smaller model variant or request a pre-pulled reserved pool. Draft message on #customer-notify: "We detected transient failures fetching some models. We've applied mitigations and recommend using cached/quantized variants to reduce cold-start failure."

Tomas V: action items:
- short (now): keep MODEL_FETCH_STRATEGY=local_then_remote on affected pools (Asha)
- mid (30m): spin up warm pool of N=10 pre-pulled containers for top-5 enterprise models (infra)
- mid (30m): add preemptive promotion of cached shards (Asha/infra)
- long: integrate authenticated HF CDN tokens into artifact fetcher + retry budget (eng-ml)

oncall-bot: Handoff requested: @Tomas V will take over the incident for next shift at 02:45 UTC.

Tomas V: taking over. @Priya S please own customer comms, Asha please continue cache promotion. I'll coordinate downstream config and HF ticket.

Priya S: customer comms posted to internal queue. Sent initial note to cust-omega and cust-sigma asking them to hold non-critical deploys until we confirm stability.

Asha M: 02:36 UTC - promoted 3 cached quantized variants to `dedicated-eu-1` pool. Cold-start error rate down to ~10% across targeted tenants.

Tomas V: good. setting incident severity to SEV2 (Customer-visible degraded experience, partial mitigation in place).

Tomas V: temporary monitoring tweaks — added alert for `external_artifact_429_rate > 5/min` per cluster and automatic pause of new provisioning if sustained > 1m.

infra-bot: Pause policy engaged for cluster `dedicated-eu-1` (reason: artifact 429 spike).

Priya S: creating post-incident action items: 1) HF CDN auth integration, 2) mirror policy for enterprise models, 3) pre-warming pools for top X models, 4) update runbook.

Tomas V: also request SRE to run tabletop with storage team on third-party rate limits.

Asha M: final note - HF confirmed they're switching to less aggressive backpressure on their side; HF will follow up in ticket HF-4529 with timeline.

Tomas V: marking this thread as incident:hf-artifact-thirdparty-rate-limit. Will write the incident summary and link to HF ticket.

customer-success-bot: Notifying CS leads about impacted accounts and escalation steps.

deploy-bot: No active rollbacks required.

Tomas V: closing coordination in this thread — follow-ups tracked in the incident board. If anything regresses ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
